rationale: Those cases are valid under the rule, yet each hides at least one equality branch. Explicit texture overrides preserve edge coverage without weakening the normal teaching distribution.

rationale: The task’s answer is an n×n equivalence matrix over three depth classes. Stability census found zero input overlap across disjoint seed ranges while output overlap remained high, which is semantic codomain reuse rather than template collapse.
summary: Output diversity is bounded by equality partitions of at most six panels, so repeated outputs are expected even with fully unique inputs.
